master_script.linkedin_english: If you run a cafe, your WhatsApp may ring at 11 p.m. and go unanswered until morning. A mobile-first website with WhatsApp and call buttons makes it easy for customers to find and contact you anytime. Comment SITE, and I will send you a one-page checklist of what customers judge on your website, with an honest note on whether you need a new one.

marketing.gets: a one-page checklist: 10 things a customer judges your website on, with an honest note on whether you need a new one

facts.claim: A WhatsApp number does not appear in Google search results, so without a website new customers cannot find you
facts.title: Why Your Business Needs a Website, Not Just WhatsApp

facts.claim: WhatsApp cannot show a full catalogue; owners must send individual photos or PDFs that load slowly, preventing customers from browsing at their own pace
facts.title: Why Your Business Needs a Website, Not Just WhatsApp

facts.claim: A weak or missing call-to-action on a website, such as lacking a "WhatsApp Us Now" button, converts significantly worse than a pre-filled WhatsApp click-to-chat message
facts.title: 10 Website Mistakes Costing Indian Small Businesses Leads in 2026

facts.claim: 61.6% of homepages had no contact form
facts.title: State of Small Business Websites 2026: Data from 1,568 Businesses Astra Labs

facts.claim: 54.8% of homepages had no tap-to-call link
facts.title: State of Small Business Websites 2026: Data from 1,568 Businesses Astra Labs

facts.claim: 52.2% of homepages lacked any one-tap call or message option, with WhatsApp links being rare
facts.title: State of Small Business Websites 2026: Data from 1,568 Businesses Astra Labs

facts.claim: Corporate clients often request a website link as a trust signal; a WhatsApp number alone looks informal and can miss professional credibility
facts.title: Why Your Business Needs a Website, Not Just WhatsApp

master_script.topic: Top 3 website mistakes that force you to repeat your rates and details on WhatsApp every day.
